Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

We acknowledge your renewal offer and the cost context set out in your message. In accordance with your approval rules, please submit our price proposal to your pricing committee for approval; we also seek a longer contract term, extended payment terms and greater call-off flexibility.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 4,580 units per year for 36 months, 13,740 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 427.22 per unit, 90 days net, 36-month contract, 4,580 units per year. This amounts to about EUR 5,870,003 over the term.
3. Basis: Our should-cost estimate for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020). Our demand forecast for this part is up +10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09), and we commit 4,580 units a year. Your on-time delivery over the last 12 months was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
4. Next step: You told us that price changes above 2% need your pricing committee. Please put this proposal to your pricing committee: a binding 36-month agreement for 13,740 units, about EUR 5,870,003. On the committee's written confirmation we issue the order the same day, and we pay every invoice on the due date.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For your information:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We acknowledge your proposal and are prepared to agree to the 36-month contract duration to ensure long-term supply stability.
We must, however, insist on maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, as extended terms of 90 days are not feasible.
In exchange for the 36-month commitment and acknowledging your operational data, we propose a revised price of €432.15 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €429.22 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
